title: Tiny Fee and Surcharge Leak
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn category=fees
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(amount) as fee_spend, count as fees by _time
| sort - _time
description: Adds up all the tiny service fees, ATM charges, and surcharges that hide in the noise.
value: Small fees feel harmless because each one is annoying rather than dramatic, but together they are pure leakage.
implementation: Categorise micro-transactions in `index=personal`; total recurring small fees each month.
visualization: Monthly chart of fee spend and count of fee events.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks all the little fees and surcharges that quietly leak money without buying you anything useful.
